battle.name: 宋魏河南之戰
battle.brief: 宋元嘉二十三年、北魏景和三年，太武帝拓跋燾乘北方統一之勢，分三道南伐，攻劉宋黃河南岸防線。宋軍以弓弩礌石死守虎牢、洛陽、滑台、壽陽，魏軍以撞車雲梯攻城；劉彌之率五萬眾反攻，一度收復洛陽。虎牢關終被攻拔，滑台檀道濟量沙而全軍還，魏軍糧道不濟退回平城。連弩即守城弩砲之源流。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰一方是北魏。太武帝拓跋燾以平城為都，此時北魏已平定河北、關中與河西，拓跋部騎兵為國家主力，漢人將領與鮮卑貴族共同分掌兵柄。景和三年（430）秋，燾自率中軍南下，另遣冠軍將軍奚康率步騎專攻虎牢關，中書令穆亮率騎兵向洛陽、豫州方向施壓，三道大軍互為犄角，目標是宋人在黃河南岸的整條防線。北魏的後勤以平城為總樞，牛車運糧沿河套、汾水轉運，再渡黃河送抵前線，並輔以河北諸州的就地徵發。另一方是劉宋。宋文帝劉義隆坐鎮建康，前線分屬豫、司、徐、兗諸州：司州刺史劉寬鎮虎牢關，豫州治壽陽，徐州刺史檀道濟統兵在滑台一線；大軍主將劉彌之率五萬眾反攻洛陽，一度入城。戰事由朝廷分派到各州刺史手上，權責分散、彼此不相統屬，這種指揮結構在戰局失利時屢屢顯出破綻。
countriesEn: One of the two belligerents was Northern Wei. Emperor Taiwu Tuoba Tao ruled from Pingcheng, and by this time Wei had already pacified Hebei, Guanzhong and the Hexi Corridor; the Tuoba cavalry formed the backbone of its armies, while Han Chinese generals and Xianbei aristocrats shared out the military commands. In the autumn of Jinghe 3 (430) the emperor took the central host south in person, gave the Champion General Xi Kang a detached force of foot and horse to press the attack on Hulao Pass, and sent the Director of the Secretariat Mu Liang with cavalry to work along Luoyang and the Yu province front, so that three columns would pincer one another and strike at the whole Song defensive line south of the Yellow River. Wei logistics ran out of Pingcheng: grain was carted down through the Hetao corridor and the Fen valley, then ferried across the Yellow River to the forward areas, supplemented by in-kind levies from the Hebei provinces. The other belligerent was the Liu Song. Emperor Wen Liu Yilong sat in Jiankang, and the front was split among the provinces of Yu, Si, Xu and Yan: the Inspector of Si Liu Kuan held Hulao Pass, the province of Yu was based at Shouyang, the Inspector of Xu Tan Daoji commanded in the line of Huatai, while the field commander Liu Mizhi led fifty thousand men in a counter-stroke against Luoyang and briefly entered the city. Command was handed out from the capital to the provincial inspectors, authority was scattered and the commanders did not answer to one another, and that fractured structure showed its weakness whenever the fighting turned against them.
people: 北魏太武帝拓跋燾是這場戰爭的軸心。他自前一年北擊柔然之後，便視劉宋北境為必取之地；430年南下時自將中軍直趨洛陽，把攻城與野戰併在一起，用意是趁宋人防線出現空隙，一舉拿下虎牢、洛陽、壽陽三處支點。他同時面對內部障礙：據《魏書》所載，景和三年北魏朝廷曾大誅宗室與軍中不附者，內部不靖，東征的時機因此被若干朝臣視為急於求成。冠軍將軍奚康受命攻虎牢，是魏軍突破關隘的尖刀；中書令穆亮統騎兵在黃河南岸與洛陽一線周旋，牽制宋軍不能全力支援關城。劉宋方面，司州刺史劉寬守虎牢最為死守，以弓弩與礌石抵禦雲梯、撞車，城破之後與所部同歿；前任司州刺史劉道產已病歿於任上，關防在換將之際出現空隙。主將劉彌之則是全場反擊的主角：他乘魏軍分兵、糧道未固之際率五萬眾直趨洛陽，與魏主燾親率的精騎相遇而大破之，盡獲洛陽器械而入城，替宋廷挽回了洛陽門戶；但次年魏軍再攻，河南諸地重入魏手。徐州刺史檀道濟在滑台與魏主燾相持，糧盡之際用唱籌量沙之計，使追兵疑有伏而退，全軍得以生還，卻也自認是僥倖，其後仍在元嘉十三年被劉義隆賜死，成為劉宋北防崩解的一個註腳。
peopleEn: Emperor Taiwu Tuoba Tao of Northern Wei was the pivot of the whole war. After campaigning north against the Rouran a year earlier he had come to treat the Song border as ground that had to be taken; when he marched south in 430 he led the central host straight at Luoyang, combining siege and field operations, in order to seize the three anchors of Hulao, Luoyang and Shouyang while the Song line showed a gap. At the same time he was hampered from within: the Wei records state that in Jinghe 3 the court executed a batch of clan members and officers who were out of favour, and the resulting disorder meant that some courtiers saw the eastern campaign as a move forced on by impatience. The Champion General Xi Kang was given the command of attacking Hulao and served as the spear point that broke the pass; the Director of the Secretariat Mu Liang worked his cavalry along the southern bank of the Yellow River and around Luoyang, so that the Song could not concentrate everything on relieving the pass. On the Song side the Inspector of Si Liu Kuan was the most tenacious defender of Hulao, meeting scaling ladders and battering rams with crossbows and stone missiles, and when the city fell he perished together with the men under him; his predecessor Liu Daochan had already died of illness in office, so the pass was short of a commander at the moment of handover. The field commander Liu Mizhi was the hero of the Song counter-stroke: taking advantage of the Wei forces being split and their supply line not yet secured, he marched straight for Luoyang with fifty thousand men, met the elite cavalry the Wei emperor led in person, defeated it and captured the baggage and engines left in Luoyang before entering the city, recovering the gateway for the Song court; but the following year the Wei attacked again and the towns of Henan returned to Wei hands. The Inspector of Xu Tan Daoji stood off against the Wei emperor at Huatai and, when his own supplies ran out, had the singing-of-tally-and-measuring-of-sand ruse used, which convinced the pursuers that ambushes were waiting and let his whole army get away, though he himself called it no more than luck; he was still executed by Liu Yilong in Yuanjia 13, and that later undoing of a great general became one of the markers of the collapse of the Song northern defence.
kits: 卡面這件秦連弩，是漢末三國文獻中的老兵器：弩機以筋鍵蓄力，踩下踏板即可連發，東漢馬援曾上連弩之奏，諸葛亮又損益其制。它代表的是一機蓄力、單兵連射的守城火力概念。時間到了宋元嘉二十三年，這種早期連弩早已退居次要，前線真正大量服役的是擘張弩、蹶張弩與弓：張弦需數人合力，箭程遠而勁，專射城垛、攻具與密集隊形；更重型的床弩則用絞盤上弦，一次可洞穿甲兵與城垛，是守城的骨幹火力。連弩的技術並未斷絕，而是被吸收進這套弩砲體系，後來宋代兵書所載的神臂弓一類強弩，設計譜系仍可上追溯到南北朝的擘張、蹶張之制。實際交戰雙方的攻城與守城配備大致如此：北魏軍備有撞車、雲梯、樓車以及載兵的攻城具，攻城時以盾車蔽弩、以梯兵緣城；劉宋守軍在虎牢關、洛陽、壽陽諸城備礌石、拒馬、鹿角，設投石機以擊攻城具，弓弩則沿城垛分層配置，形成交叉射界。洛陽反攻一役，宋軍盡獲魏軍器械，弩機、弩矢、攻城具與糧械成為繳獲重點。兩軍糧運以牛車、驢隊為主，軍中大量使用旌旗、鼓角與戎馬，魏軍騎兵尤重控弦與奔襲，屢在宋軍退路側翼出現。
kitsEn: The repeating crossbow on the card face is an old weapon from the late Han and Three Kingdoms literature: the lock stores the pull of the bow in a sinew and the soldier can keep firing by stamping a treadle, and in the Eastern Han Ma Yuan once presented a memorial on the repeating crossbow while Zhuge Liang later reworked the design. What it represents is the concept of a siege weapon that stores its power in the mechanism and lets a single soldier fire repeatedly. By the time of Yuanjia 23 in the Song, that early type had long since become secondary; what was actually massed on the front line were the crossbows cocked by main strength and by foot pressure, and the bow: stringing them took several men, the bolts reached far and struck hard, and they were used against parapets, siege engines and massed formations; the heavier bed crossbow, cocked by a windlass, could pierce both armoured men and parapets and formed the backbone of the garrison firepower. The repeating crossbow line was not cut off but absorbed into that system, and the powerful crossbows such as the divine arm bow recorded in later Song military manuals trace their design pedigree back to the Northern and Southern dynasties. The actual equipment on both sides ran as follows: the Wei army carried battering rams, scaling ladders, siege towers and other man-carrying engines, advancing under the cover of shield carts with ladder troops climbing the walls; the Song garrisons at Hulao Pass, Luoyang and Shouyang stocked stone missiles, cheval-de-frise and deer-horn obstacles, mounted stone-throwing engines to break up the siege engines, and laid their bows and crossbows in layers along the parapet to create interlocking fields of fire. In the counter-stroke at Luoyang the Song captured from the Wei, in the words of the records, very nearly the whole of the equipment and baggage left in the city, and the crossbow locks, bolts, siege engines and stores were the prizes of the hour. Both sides moved grain by ox cart and mule train, the armies used a great many banners, drums and war-horns, and Wei cavalry, trained to control their bow in the saddle and to strike hard, repeatedly appeared on the flanks of the withdrawing Song columns.
tactics: 魏軍的戰法是先取支點、再圖大局。分道進兵之後，奚康一軍圍攻虎牢關，太武帝自將中軍直抵洛陽城下，兩處同時施壓，目的是迫使宋人分兵、消耗其援軍；騎兵又在黃河沿岸與洛陽一線游弋，斷宋軍由南向北的糧道與傳令。攻城有固定程序：先以步騎清除城外的塹、柵與援軍據點，用撞車撞擊城門與城壁，以雲梯貼城，梯兵在弩矢掩護下攀城。宋軍則憑關城地險，以步弩手沿城垛分番射擊，床弩瞄準雲梯與撞車，礌石與投石機招呼密集的攻城隊，屢次把魏軍逼退。宋軍的反擊則抓魏軍分兵、糧道未固的空隙：劉彌之以五萬眾乘魏主力與別部相離之際直趨洛陽，在城外與魏主燾親率的精騎正面交鋒而取勝，盡奪魏軍器械，隨即入城設守；這一手的關鍵唔係人數，而係齊整的集中突擊同魏軍內部調度不及。宋軍另一手是拖法：檀道濟屯滑台，與魏主燾隔水相持，魏軍遠來糧盡，燾焚攻城具退走，宋軍用唱籌量沙示以糧足，使追兵狐疑而止，如此保存了主力。撤退與追擊的規矩也見於史：魏軍退時焚燒攻城器械以延遲追擊，又藉黃河天塹斷宋軍追兵；宋軍各部缺乏統一號令，一退便各自奔散，途中屢被魏騎咬住尾隊。
tacticsEn: The Wei way of war was to take the anchor points first and only then think of the larger picture. Once the columns had advanced, the army of Xi Kang ringed Hulao Pass while the emperor led the central host down to the walls of Luoyang, applying pressure in two places at once in order to force the Song to split its forces and wear out its reinforcements; the cavalry meanwhile patrolled the bank of the Yellow River and the Luoyang sector, cutting the Song supply line and despatch route that ran from south to north. Siege followed a fixed routine: foot and horse first cleared the ditches, palisades and forward posts outside the walls; battering rams were set against gates and walls; scaling ladders were brought up to the face of the wall and ladder troops climbed under the cover of crossbow fire. The Song in turn relied on the ground of the pass, with foot crossbowmen firing in relays from the parapets, bed crossbows aimed squarely at the ladders and rams, and stone missiles and stone-throwing engines falling on the crowded assault columns, driving the Wei back more than once. The Song counter-stroke seized the moment when the Wei army was split and its supply line not yet secured: Liu Mizhi marched straight for Luoyang with fifty thousand men while the Wei main body and its detached columns were separated, fought the elite cavalry the Wei emperor led in person in open battle outside the walls and won, stripped the Wei of its engines and baggage, and entered the city to garrison it; the key to that move was not numbers but a concentrated, co-ordinated blow delivered before the Wei could adjust its dispositions. The Song second string was delay: Tan Daoji held Huatai and stood off against the Wei emperor across the water; the Wei army, far from its base, ran out of food, so the emperor burned his siege engines and withdrew, and the Song answered by singing the tally and measuring the sand to show the pursuers that stores were ample, which shook them into halting and left the Song main force intact. The rules for withdrawal and pursuit are also on record: the Wei burned their engines on the way out to slow the pursuit and used the Yellow River itself to break up the Song horse that followed; the Song columns, lacking a single command signal, scattered as soon as they turned, and their trailing parties were repeatedly caught by the Wei cavalry on the march.
data: 本戰的數字在傳世史籍裏多以約數出現，須小心對待。時間線是：元嘉二十三年即北魏景和三年（430）秋，拓跋燾議定南伐；同年十月至十一月之間大軍渡黃河，兵鋒直指虎牢與洛陽；其後一年的冬天，魏軍再度南下，重新奪回河南一帶的部分城邑。距離方面，虎牢關在洛陽城西北，兩地相去約六十餘里，正是關城能屏蔽洛陽的地理前提；平城至洛陽的陸路逾千里，黃河各渡口之間的距離多在數百里之譜，這也是魏軍糧道拉長、回糧困難的根源。兵力的記錄以萬眾、大軍一類概數為主，可核者有宋將劉彌之率五萬眾反攻洛陽一例；與此同時被圍攻的虎牢關守軍則是區區數千人，比例懸殊。圍城的時間以相持數月形容魏軍攻虎牢，至滑台一役亦見數十日之久的對峙。全場可大致標記的遠景數字還有：劉宋此後仍能抵禦魏主燾於449至450年南征至瓜步，而拓跋燾於452年病歿於北方行在。
dataEn: The figures for this war come down to rough approximations in the transmitted histories, and they have to be handled with care. The timeline runs: in the autumn of Yuanjia 23, which is Jinghe 3 of Northern Wei (430), Tuoba Tao resolved on the southern campaign; between the tenth and eleventh months of that year the great army crossed the Yellow River with its points directed at Hulao and Luoyang; and in the winter of the following year the Wei marched south again and retook a number of the towns of the Henan area. As for distances, Hulao Pass lay north-west of the city of Luoyang at a separation of a little over sixty li, which is precisely the geographical premise on which the pass shielded Luoyang; the overland road from Pingcheng to Luoyang exceeded a thousand li, and the crossings of the Yellow River were in general several hundred li apart, which is the root of the long Wei supply line and of the difficulty of bringing grain back. Records of strength are mostly in round figures such as tens of thousands of men or a great host; the one figure that can be checked is the fifty thousand men the Song general Liu Mizhi led against Luoyang, whereas the garrison holding Hulao Pass under siege numbered only a few thousand, a stark disproportion. The length of the siege is given as several months of stalemate for the Wei attack on Hulao, and the stand at Huatai is likewise described as a confrontation lasting tens of days. The larger numbers that can be set against the horizon of the campaign are these: the Liu Song afterwards still held off the Wei emperor when he campaigned south in 449 and 450 as far as Guabu, and Tuoba Tao died of illness at his northern camp in 452.
cause: 打起上來的緣由有三層。第一層是地緣：洛陽所在的河南，是魏宋兩家爭鋒的樞紐，誰佔洛陽，誰就握有向南方進取的門戶，也把河北與江南之間的距離縮去大半。北魏自439年統一河西以來，中原大部已在掌中，太武帝要把邊界推到淮水，就必須先解決河南。第二層是國勢的差距：北魏在馬上打出的騎兵、與漢地編戶和糧秣結合的後勤，使它有能力在一年之內把大批生聚與糧草搬到前線；劉宋雖據江南富庶，卻在北線屢失州郡，士氣與名將都沒有補足。第三層是時機：北魏在對柔然的戰事之後，趁劉宋內部對北伐與守禦的爭論未息，決定先發制人；而宋廷在此之前屢次北伐失利，邊鎮與朝廷互不信任，這種裂縫被魏廷看見並利用。直接導火線則是北線兩國在虎牢、洛陽一線的守軍摩擦與叛逃往來，魏軍藉整頓防務的名義集結大軍，實際上越河南下；而宋廷在魏軍深入之後又乘隙反攻洛陽，令魏廷無法接受河南再失，遂有次年再度南征。
causeEn: There were three layers behind the outbreak. The first was geography: Henan, the country around Luoyang, was the hinge on which Wei and Song contested, and whoever held Luoyang held the gateway to expansion in the south while cutting most of the distance between Hebei and Jiangnan. Since unifying the Hexi Corridor in 439, Wei already held the greater part of the Central Plain, and for the emperor to push the frontier down to the Huai he had to settle Henan first. The second layer was the gap in national strength: the cavalry forged on horseback, together with the logistics that married Han household registration to grain and fodder, gave Wei the capacity to move large numbers of men, animals and supplies to the front within a single year; the Liu Song, rich in the south, had repeatedly lost provinces on the northern line, and neither morale nor great generals had been replenished there. The third layer was timing: after its fighting against the Rouran, Wei moved first while the Song court was still arguing between northward expeditions and passive defence, and after a run of failed northern campaigns the Song border commands and the capital no longer trusted one another, a seam the Wei court saw and used. The immediate spark was friction between the garrisons of the two states along Hulao and Luoyang, with desertions running both ways; the Wei used the language of reorganisation of the frontier to concentrate a great army, and crossed the Yellow River southward. When the Song court struck back at Luoyang once the Wei had penetrated, the Wei could not accept the loss of Henan again, and marched south the following year.
impact: 對劉宋，這是一場把北線形勢推低、但同時留下反攻經驗的戰役。虎牢關一度失守意味著洛陽門戶洞開，河南防線整體內縮到淮水一帶，宋廷此後二十餘年只能以守禦為主；雖然劉彌之五萬眾一度收復洛陽，卻守不住，翌年洛陽重入魏手，此後再未收復。450年（宋元嘉二十七年）魏主燾再率大軍南下，兵鋒直抵瓜步、逼近長江，江南為之震動，劉宋靠盱眙等要塞的堅守與魏軍自身的疲病、糧秣才得以支持，魏主燾旋因疾退兵，452年病歿於北方行在。但更深遠的後果在劉宋內部：此戰之後朝廷對武將的猜忌加深，檀道濟、到彥之等名將接連被貶抑甚至處死，北線再無能與北方抗衡的名將主持。對北方，這場戰役加速了北魏的戰略成熟，也讓漢地士人更清楚地看見北朝制度的可能，同時促成鮮卑貴族對中原文化的吸收，日後孝文帝的漢化改革與494年遷都洛陽，其地理與文化前提正是在這一時期奠定。更長遠地看，洛陽自此逐步成為北朝的實際政治中心，其格局被隋唐繼承，成為唐長安之外的第二都城。
impactEn: For the Liu Song this was a campaign that pushed the northern situation downhill, while still leaving the Song with a lesson in how to counter-attack. The temporary loss of Hulao Pass opened the gateway to Luoyang and pulled the whole Henan line back to the Huai, and for more than twenty years afterwards the Song court could only think in terms of defence; although Liu Mizhi recovered Luoyang for a time with fifty thousand men, the city could not be held, fell back to the Wei the following year and was never regained. In 450, in Yuanjia 27, the Wei emperor marched south again with a great host, his spearhead reaching Guabu and pressing up to the Yangtze, and the south of the river was badly shaken; the Song held on through the stubborn defence of places such as Xuyi and through the sickness and supply problems of the Wei army itself, and the Wei emperor withdrew ill, dying at his camp in the north in 452. But the deeper consequences lay inside the Liu Song: after this war the court's distrust of military commanders deepened, and great generals such as Tan Daoji and Dao Zhizhi were demoted, imprisoned or put to death one after another, so that the northern line never again had a commander who could match the north. For the northern regime, the campaign hurried the maturation of Wei strategy, showed the Han literati of the south more clearly what a northern dynasty could become, and pushed the Xianbei aristocracy to absorb the culture of the Central Plain; the geographical and cultural premises of the later Sinicising reforms of Emperor Xiaowen and the move of the capital to Luoyang in 494 were laid down in this period. In the longer run Luoyang gradually became the effective political centre of the northern court, a pattern inherited by the Sui and the Tang, which made it the second capital of the Tang empire beside Chang'an.
result: 結算這一場：北魏在戰役中一度攻下虎牢關這一枚關鍵棋子，司州刺史劉寬與所部同歿於城；洛陽、壽陽則未能在這一輪被魏軍持久占領。滑台方向，魏主燾面對宋將檀道濟的堅持與唱籌量沙的欺敵之計，加上千里轉輸的糧道實難支撐，最終焚燒攻城具退兵北還，宋軍主力得以保全。宋軍隨後以劉彌之五萬眾反攻洛陽，一度收復西京、盡奪魏軍器械，令北魏無法忍受，次年（431）再度南下，重新奪回河南諸要地。兩國在虎牢、洛陽、壽陽一線長期拉鋸，攻守互易，南北界線大致落在淮水流域，宋人也再沒有收復洛陽。從更長的尺度看，這場戰爭沒有真正的勝負：它既沒有讓北魏一口吞下南方，也沒有讓劉宋守住河南故土，而是讓南北朝那種以長江、淮水為界、並存而對峙的格局定型下來。
resultEn: Settling the account: Northern Wei took the key piece of Hulao Pass for a time in this campaign, the Inspector of Si Liu Kuan and his men died with the walls, while Luoyang and Shouyang could not be held permanently by the Wei in this round. In the Huatai sector the Wei emperor, confronted with the obstinacy of the Song general Tan Daoji and with the deceit of the singing-tally-and-measuring-sand trick, and unable in truth to support a supply line carried a thousand li, finally burned his siege engines and withdrew north, and the main body of the Song army was preserved. The Song then struck back with Liu Mizhi and fifty thousand men, recovering the western capital of Luoyang for a time and stripping the Wei of their engines and baggage, which the northern court could not accept; in the following year, 431, it marched south again and retook the important towns of Henan. The two countries pulled at each other for a long time along the Hulao, Luoyang and Shouyang line, taking and retaking ground, the boundary between north and south settling broadly along the Huai basin; the Song never recovered Luoyang. Measured on a longer scale the war had no real winner: it neither let Wei swallow the south in one bite nor let the Liu Song hold the old homeland of Henan, and instead it fixed the Southern and Northern Dynasties pattern of coexistence and confrontation divided by the Yangtze and the Huai.
